caption: The drawing depicts a three-piece men's suit from the 18th century, consisting of a dark blue coat, matching knee-breeches, and a light-colored waistcoat. The coat and breeches are made of a blue fabric patterned with small, light-colored dots and have a tailored fit; the coat features wide cuffs with buttons and is cut long in the back. The waistcoat, visible under the coat, is light beige with small, colorful floral embroidery in shades of pink, green, and blue, and is trimmed with a blue edge. The suit is shown on a faceless, headless mannequin, with the shirt collar and a white ruffled cravat at the neck. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a simple outline sketch showing the back view of the same outfit, indicating details like the coat’s long tails and the placement of pockets. The composition has a plain, pale background, and the arrangement centers the main colored drawing, with the outline serving as a secondary point of reference.
title: Man's Suit
